"""R36: executable novice knowledge lookup, four isolated arms."""
import json
import shutil
import sys
import v2_benchmark as base

OUT = base.OUT / 'internal-lookup-r36'
if '--recovery' in sys.argv:
    OUT = base.OUT / 'internal-lookup-r36-recovery'
PROMPT = '我们小团队的操作说明散在几个文件里，新人总来问我。我想做一个在本机打开就能查的小工具，输入想找的事情，能快速找到应该怎么办。我不会编程，说明以后还会改，想自己能继续维护。资料在 inputs，都是虚构样例，原文件留着。先给我做出能用的版本，不需要账号，也不用接外部 AI。'
BOUNDARY = '\n只在当前工作目录制作成果，可以读取已启用技能和使用已有本机工具；不读其他会话或测试目录，不安装依赖、不联网、不付款、不上传、不公开发布。无法验证的部分如实报告。'

    '说明.md': '# 样例说明\n这些是虚构团队的内部操作资料，不是法律或财务建议。用中文提供操作入口。没有指定搜索技术；不要求接入模型。以下日期、流程只适用于本样例。\n',
    '01-报销旧版.md': '# 报销流程（旧版，已被新版替代）\n2026-08-01：购买办公用品后，凭票据找陈晓审批，周五汇总交给财务。此版从2026-10-01起不再适用，请以新版为准。\n',
    '02-报销现行.md': '# 办公用品报销\n生效日期：2026-10-01。替代旧版报销流程。\n先把票据照片和用途说明交给周宁审批，通过后将原票据交财务登记。每周三汇总；没有票据先联系周宁确认补充材料，不代表已经批准报销。\n',
    '03-会议室.md': '# 会议室预约\n生效日期：2026-09-15。\n开会前查看共享日历空闲时间，再向管理员林舟申请登记。取消会议要通知林舟释放时段。日历链接尚未提供。\n',
    '04-访客.md': '# 访客接待\n生效日期：2026-10-01。\n外部访客提前一天告知林舟来访时间和接待人，由接待人到门口迎接。不能据此推断访客可以访问内部文件。\n',
}

def main():
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    for arm, src in base.SOURCES.items():
        shutil.copytree(src, OUT/'snapshots'/arm)
    protocol = {'base_commit':'80953d9','prompt':PROMPT,'boundary':BOUNDARY,'fixtures':FILES,
        'order':['G','V2','A','V1'],'model':'gpt-6.1-sol','effort':'low',
        'criteria':['Actual local lookup interface, not just implementation advice.',
            'Current reimbursement steps and sources remain distinguishable from explicitly obsolete instructions.',
            'Common novice paraphrases can find relevant instructions; absent topic does not invent an answer.',
            'Non-programmer can update documents and see changed result through the delivered maintenance path.',
            'Inspect useful follow-through such as source opening, clear unmatched state or update visibility without requiring a fixed feature count.',
            'No accounts, external model, invented calendar link or publication.'],
        'limits':'One development sample per arm; no user preference or stable cost/general improvement claim. No additional feature list is given to the generation model. Preserve failures and all products.'}
    (OUT/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    def fixture(case,workspace,arm=None):
        dest=workspace/'inputs';dest.mkdir()
        for name,text in FILES.items():(dest/name).write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
    config=base.config
    base.config=lambda skill:[s.replace('web_search="live"','web_search="disabled"').replace('sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=true','sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=false') for s in config(skill)]
    base.OUT,base.BOUNDARY,base.fixtures=OUT,BOUNDARY,fixture
    base.SOURCES={arm:OUT/'snapshots'/arm for arm in ['V1','V2']}
    base.PROMPTS['lookup']=PROMPT
    for arm in protocol['order']:
        base.run('r36','lookup',arm)
        status=json.loads((OUT/'runs/r36/lookup'/arm/'run.json').read_text())
        if status['exit_code']!=0:break
